ITEM.PTXT: The oversteer tendency is determined from the vehicle slip angle and slip angular velocity, and according to the degree of the tendency, the brakes are applied mainly to the wheels on the outside of the turn to generate an outward moment, suppressing the oversteer tendency. At the same time, an assist torque command in the oversteer correction direction is sent to the EPS, controlling the steering torque so that the driver can steer more easily.
